title: skills(os-dev, pm-dispatch): PR bodies serve the seat, not the approver — every PR opens with a fixed six-line maintainer brief, verification logs fold into details, governed review is requested only after the 席位核对 comment is on the head
body:
Filing gate ③: a maintainer-directed task. Maintainer, 2026-10-26, verbatim: 「看一下现在的pr写的内容，我总感觉对我审核的人帮助不大，是否需要更新skills」 and, after the reading below, 「立卡」. Reader: the `domain:skills` execution seat, dispatch step — one os-dev, one PR; file surface `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` and `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (+ `references/execution-duties.md` / `landing-operations.md` where the request-review step lives), all `.claude/**` = Tier S (lands on a contract-review record; the maintainer rules the template's shape on the PR). Dedupe: REST list of open + closed-since-2026-09-20 issues and every issue updated since 2026-10-26T10:00Z, grep `速读|PR body|PR 正文|brief|席位核对` → 0 open hits; #25414 (closed) is the Tier S contract-review ruling, not the body shape. **New.** Session `session_019a9XCWsbMFp75REzthE6cs`. ⛔ Not a claim.

**谁付代价（业务筛）:** the maintainer, who approves every Tier H PR by hand and is the only reader the fleet cannot replace. Today a PR body is the seat's review evidence (ablation blob hashes, gate-family exit codes, test-file counts) in 4–14k characters of English, and the one channel written for the maintainer exists only on governed PRs, as a draft the seat was supposed to finish and in 4 of 6 cases did not.

## Measured (2026-10-26 ~13:00Z, the 35 open PRs on objectstack-ai/objectstack, REST `GET /pulls` + `/issues/{n}/comments`)

- Body length 1.4k–14k characters, median about 5.5k. First-section names vary per PR: `What` / `What changes` / `What this changes` / `Summary` / `The area, measured on …` / `What timed out, read from the logs` / `Why a second PR` — no fixed order a reader can scan.
- Chinese content (the maintainer's channel): present in 6 of 35, all governed-surface drafts under `## 维护者速读(草稿)`; the other 29 carry none.
- Governed PRs checked for the seat's final brief (`## 席位核对` or a non-draft 速读 comment on the PR): #26010 and #26003 have it; #26144, #26005, #26138, #26064 do not (0 comments carrying it; #26138 has 0 comments at all). On those four the maintainer reads the dev's draft with `席位意见` empty, which the rule says they should never have to (`SKILL.md:188-193`: 「席位定稿成评论」「维护者只读评论」).
- #26144's draft reads "The measurements and the exact path are with the server seat, not here" — the evidence an approver needs is pointed away from the PR.
- What the better drafts (#26005) do well: 改了什么 / 为什么改 / 风险与代价(含回滚) / 你要做的 in business language. What even they lack: which files to read first, which hunk carries the risk, how to verify in two minutes.

## Governing text

- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:288-289`: 「受管面 PR 正文带 `## 维护者速读(草稿)` 节,中文、业务角度,席位意见留空;两层同欠。五段固定:改了什么/为什么改/风险与代价(含回滚)/席位意见/你要做的;席位定稿成评论。」 — the brief is required on governed PRs only.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:188-194` (路径分叉 ①–②): the seat's record on a Tier H PR is 置顶速读五段 + `## 席位核对`; the draft is the dev's; the final is the seat's; 「维护者只读评论」.
- `SKILL.md:97`: 「GitHub 上一切新内容用英文;中文只留四通道(维护者速读、轮报、裁决引文、四维分析)」 — the brief is already one of the four Chinese channels, so extending it to every PR is within the rule.
- `references/review-checklist.md` 「测试与门禁证据」: the evidence the body carries today is what this checklist asks the SEAT to verify; nothing there is addressed to the approver.
- #25919 ruling A (comment 6386217274): 「规范核心与事故史分家」 — the same direction: judgement up front, mechanism behind.
- `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: SKILL.md's line count only goes down; additions are paid for by deletions in the same PR (ruling id otherwise). The dev budgets the edit accordingly.

## Wanted

**1. `os-dev.md` — one brief on every PR, not only governed ones.** The PR body opens (after the `Fixes/Part of` line and the two declaration lines) with a fixed block, Chinese, at most six lines, in this order and with these labels:

```
## 维护者速读
改了什么:<一句业务语言,用户或作者看到的变化>
为什么改:<卡/裁决/实测的一句>
风险与回滚:<放宽还是收窄;出错时谁看到什么;回滚是 revert 还是删一个键>
先看:<最多 3 个文件路径,按风险排序,风险所在的那个 hunk 用一句话点名>
两分钟验证:<一条命令或一次点击,预期看到什么>
需要你做的:<恰好一个动作;非受管面 PR 写「无,席位落地」>
```

Then the English sections in a fixed order and with fixed names: `## What changes` · `## Tests` · `## Acceptance notes` · `## Verification`. Everything under `## Verification` that is a log reading (gate-family counts and exit codes, ablation blob hashes, test-file totals, lock-slot readings) goes inside a `<details><summary>…</summary>` block, one per sub-topic, so the body reads as judgement first and evidence on demand. `## 维护者速读(草稿)` is renamed to the block above on governed PRs too; the dev leaves no `席位意见` line (that line is the seat's, in the seat's comment).

**2. `pm-dispatch` — the seat's final brief is a precondition of asking for governed review.** Before the relay `pr_ready` / request to `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` on a Tier H PR, and before a Tier S PR is queued, the seat's `## 席位核对` comment (the five-paragraph brief with 席位意见 filled, plus the six-item check) must exist on the PR for the current head. Mechanism: one row in the report-only half-state patrol (`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`: a Tier H PR with reviewers requested and no `席位核对` comment newer than its head commit = a half state), ⛔ not a new required gate. The ACCEPT comment names the brief comment id.

**3. ⛔ Not in scope:** rewriting the 35 open PR bodies (PR bodies are written once by the dev; `os-dev.md` 「PR 正文 dev 只写一次」); any change to what the seat verifies (`review-checklist.md` stays); any English → Chinese change outside the brief.

## Acceptance

- `os-dev.md` carries the block verbatim with the six labels, and the fixed section order; `pm-dispatch` carries the precondition and the patrol row; `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:skill-frame-sync` green; `.claude/hooks/*.selftest.sh` and `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test` green with the new row covered by a case.
- The first three dev PRs dispatched after this lands open with the block, and their `## Verification` bodies are folded; the seat's ACCEPT on each names the `席位核对` comment id.
- Contract review record on this PR (`## Contract review`, `Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, because `.claude/**` is a governed rule-text surface) with the maintainer's word on the template's shape quoted in the PR's own brief.

**Size:** S–M (two rule files, one patrol row, one self-test case). **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none. **Tier:** S (`.claude/**`).

## Related

#25919 (open, ruled A: 规范与叙事分家), #25414 (closed: Tier S contract-review record), #25765 (open: independent full review on published spec/skills/ADR PRs), #26081 (decision card: AGENTS.md shape).
